title: The higher-dimensional Erdős distinct-distances conjecture
summary: For every fixed integer d ≥ 3, we prove that every set of n ≥ 2 distinct points in ℝ d determines at least $`c_d n^{2/d}`$ distinct distances, where $`c_d\gt 0`$ depends only on d . This resolves the higher-dimensional Erdős distinct-distances conjecture positively.

review.reason: Proves a distinct-distances lower bound for point sets in dimensions three and higher.
